name: features
description: Complete bulleted list of all discoverable product features and specifications.
system_prompt_additions: Extract every identifiable feature, specification, and selling point. Each feature should be a concise phrase (not a full sentence) that names the feature and its benefit, e.g. 'GDDR6 memory — ultra-fast bandwidth for high-resolution gaming'. Include as many features as the source data supports. Do not duplicate or invent features not present in the search results.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
features: string — feature with brief benefit explanation (array, no fixed limit)
